logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Analytical illustration for the WO-05 fleet-charger decision report. A single-column energy-ladder chart compares all four qualifying packages on the shared acceptance basis: bars for P2 15 kWh, P3 24 kWh, P1 44 kWh and P4 64 kWh, ordered ascending, with P2 highlighted as the client-correct minimum and a dashed P2-minimum reference line at 15 kWh. Each bar carries its measured kWh label, its level ratio versus P2 (1.60x, 2.93x, 4.27x) and a defect-headroom chip (4/5, 2/5, 2/5, 0/5). Consecutive gap callouts (+9, +20, +20 kWh) sit between adjacent bars along the ascending step. An x-axis strip restates each package's quality and defect counts; a footer restates that all four packages pass both client gates, that ranking is by energy with candidate ID used only for ties, and that P3 at 24 kWh is the explicit fallback. Style: clean sans-serif, white background, muted blue-gray bars with one accent color for P2; no decorative elements.
